subject: Vendor cascade: subcontracting carveouts and DPA encryption annex sequencing
messages:
From: Sabrina Wu <sabrina.wu@edgewave.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@edgewave.com
Date: 2028-09-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor chain: proposed subcontracting encryption language and DPA annex

Hi Dylan / Kimberly,

Per our due diligence cycle, we need to flow down a small set of encryption and key management obligations to an impending subcontractor (LogStream Inc.) that will process telemetry under the Order Form. Attached is our proposed "Encryption Annex" (edgewave_encryption_annex_v1.docx) and a short redline of the MSA order-form carve. The vendor is requesting a narrow carveout for operational logs (retention metadata) but otherwise must meet the KMS requirements.

High-level asks from EdgeWave:
- Can Redwood accept an explicit KMS-integration requirement (customer-managed keys via HSM) or do you need a more generic encryption-at-rest + key-rotation clause?
- Are there insurance / liability caps that will prevent you from passing this downstream?
- Given this is a new subcontractor, can Redwood provide a timeline for legal sign-off and order-form amendment? We are on a procurement timeline and trying to close by end of month.

We are happy to take a call, but wanted to share the docs first.

Attachments: edgewave_encryption_annex_v1.docx (draft), redline_msa_orderform_v2.docx (annotated)

Thanks,
Sabrina Wu
Senior Contracts Manager
EdgeWave Systems

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sabrina Wu <sabrina.wu@edgewave.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-13T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor chain: proposed subcontracting encryption language and DPA annex

Hi Sabrina — thanks for the materials. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (procurement/ops) to scope impact. Quick ack and proposed internal owners: Kimberly — legal redlines + DPA annex mapping; Marissa — order-form billing/term impacts and signature timeline.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Kimberly, can you review the vendor-proposed KMS binding (customer-managed HSM) vs. our current MSA language and advise whether we can accept as-is or need alternate wording?
- Marissa, any concerns on the procurement side for adding the subcontractor now vs. after signature? Will this require a new order form?

Sabrina — we'll aim to get you a go/no-go on the language by the 17th. If you have specific compliance attestations from LogStream (SOC2 + KMS attestation), please attach.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Sabrina Wu <sabrina.wu@edgewave.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-14T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor chain: proposed subcontracting encryption language and DPA annex

Dylan / Sabrina — thanks for the drafts. I reviewed edgewave_encryption_annex_v1 and redline_msa_orderform_v2. Key observations: 

1) KMS requirement: EdgeWave's ask for "customer-managed keys (HSM)" is stronger than our standard MSA which currently allows provider-managed keys with contractual rotation commitments. If EdgeWave requires HSM, we need to ensure:
   - Compatibility with our Private (VPC/on-prem) offering only; hosted customers cannot provide customer-managed HSM today without a Private deployment.
   - A clear mechanism for key custody transfer and termination (who zeroizes keys on offboarding).

2) Liability / insurance: The annex attempts to expand liability for data processing failures tied to key mismanagement. We should try to cap liability at the existing MSA cap unless EdgeWave provides reciprocal indemnities and additional insurance.

3) Third-party subprocessor clause: The proposed flow-down is generally acceptable, but we should add a limited carveout for operational telemetry logs that LogStream will process for diagnosis — retention <= 30 days and access controls tied to a named engineer list.

I attached a redline with alternative language (redline_msa_orderform_v2_legal_comments.docx) that: (a) provides an option if EdgeWave insists on HSM (conditional on Private deployment), (b) tightens the DPA annex to require key escrow/zeroization notes, and (c) proposes a 30-day retention cap for telemetry.

Attachments: redline_msa_orderform_v2_legal_comments.docx

Next steps:
- Sabrina: please confirm whether EdgeWave can accept the telemetry carveout and whether LogStream can provide the KMS attestation.
- Connor/Marissa: FYI on the Private deployment implication and order-form amendment.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Sabrina Wu <sabrina.wu@edgewave.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@edgewave.com
Date: 2028-09-16T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor chain: proposed subcontractting encryption language and DPA annex

Kimberly — thanks for the quick review and suggestions. A few clarifications from EdgeWave side: 

- LogStream can support HSM-backed keys but only in tenant environments where the processor supports Bring-Your-Own-Key; they cannot accommodate hosted shared-key customers. EdgeWave's requirement for HSM is non-negotiable for this workload (regulated telemetry).
- The telemetry carveout is acceptable with the 30-day retention cap you proposed, provided access is strictly logged and reviewed quarterly.
- On liability: EdgeWave is open to a reciprocal indemnity and increasing insurance limits, but cannot fully waive the expanded liability language — they will accept a negotiated cap tied to the order value (pro rata).

We will ask LogStream for the SOC2 + KMS attestation; expect a response from them by Thursday EOD.

If Redwood can confirm Private deployment compatibility and a likely timeline for legal sign-off, we can push procurement to target a 9/30 close.

Regards,
Sabrina

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sabrina Wu <sabrina.wu@edgewave.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-18T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor cascade: subcontracting carveouts and DPA encryption annex sequencing

Thanks everyone — quick procurement/ops note:

- If EdgeWave insists on HSM and we need to ship LogStream on a Private deployment, that will change the order-form SKU and increase monthly committed spend approximately 2.3x relative to hosted. We need explicit signoff from the account for that delta.
- DocuSign path: best-case timeline assuming legal sign-off on 9/20 is DocuSign queue and signatures by 9/25. If LogStream's attestation lands and legal approves earlier, we can accelerate.
- I'll prepare a short amendment template (order-form amendment + billing appendix) and link to the HubSpot deal. See link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/459-EDGE-WF

Attachments: orderform_amendment_template.docx (stub)

Connor — can you confirm whether engineering ops needs a security review slot before deployment? If so, we should schedule now.

Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
